verdict.rationale: Canny's own integrations push feedback items into delivery tools (Jira, Linear, GitHub, ClickUp, Asana), link them to issues and sync statuses. Its official MCP server lets a developer in Cursor or Claude pull request context, draft PRDs and build the features. However, what moves into the workflow is feedback or ideas rather than an approved specification artifact. Missing for 10: a first-class spec/PRD object with an approval state, a documented flow that hands an approved spec into Jira/Linear/GitHub tasks, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pull an approved product specification into the delivery workflow to start implementation
